components.name: Panel Button
components.description: Square raised launcher button with an inverted pressed state.
components.css: .ds-panel-button { background:#b8b4a5; color:#242724; padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid #6e6c64; border-top-color:#d3d0c2; border-left-color:#d3d0c2; border-radius:0; font:700 12px monospace; } .ds-panel-button:hover,.ds-panel-button:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #4e5869; outline-offset:1px; } .ds-panel-button:active { border-color:#d3d0c2; border-top-color:#6e6c64; border-left-color:#6e6c64; }

components.name: Terminal Window
components.description: The real kernel console inside classic one-pixel chrome.
components.css: .ds-terminal { width:420px; border:1px solid #6e6c64; border-top-color:#d3d0c2; border-left-color:#d3d0c2; border-radius:0; background:#b8b4a5; color:#242724; font:14px monospace; padding:2px; } .ds-terminal header { background:#4e5869; color:#c9c8b5; padding:5px 7px; font-weight:700; } .ds-terminal pre { min-height:180px; margin:2px 0 0; padding:8px; background:#171a17; color:#c9c8b5; border:1px solid #6e6c64; } .ds-terminal:focus-within { outline:1px solid #4e5869; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Desktop Icon
components.description: Text-led bitmap icon with no modern tile container.
components.css: .ds-desktop-icon { display:grid; gap:4px; justify-items:center; width:72px; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:4px; background:transparent; color:#c9c8b5; font:700 12px monospace; } .ds-desktop-icon span { color:#242724; background:#b8b4a5; border:1px solid #d3d0c2; border-right-color:#6e6c64; border-bottom-color:#6e6c64; padding:8px 5px; } .ds-desktop-icon:hover,.ds-desktop-icon:focus-visible { outline:1px dotted #c9c8b5; }

narrative.overview: Argus 9OS feels like a maintained computer in a dim room around the turn of the millennium: practical, slightly severe, and built for legibility. It combines old Linux desktop economy, early imageboard density, and tactile one-pixel system chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Muted olive field with warm gray system chrome
Square corners and crisp one-pixel bevels
Small bitmap type with compact, keyboard-first labels
One desaturated title color and one rare oxblood state color
Real system status in place of decorative widgets

rules.name: The Dust Rule
rules.body: No fully saturated color appears anywhere. Accent color stays under ten percent of a screen and always communicates state.

rules.name: The Integer Pixel Rule
rules.body: Glyphs are scaled only by whole numbers and never smoothed, stretched, or shadowed.

rules.name: The One-Pixel Bevel Rule
rules.body: Every raised or recessed edge uses exactly one highlight and one shadow line. Never stack ornamental borders.

dos: Do use #4c5148 as the dominant field and #b8b4a5 for system chrome.
Do use square corners and exact one-pixel highlight/shadow edges.
Do show real keyboard, storage, and shell state in terse language.
Do keep the terminal readable with #c9c8b5 on #171a17.
Do preserve keyboard and serial access for every important action.
donts: Don't make ArgusOS a glossy Windows XP clone or a literal 4chan clone.
Don't use copied Microsoft or imageboard artwork, icons, trademarks, or layout.
Don't use neon cyberpunk accents, gradients, glassmorphism, or rounded cards.
Don't use a colored side stripe on any panel or item.
Don't animate anything that does not communicate a state change.
